questions.question: how the FITT formula can be individualized based on age, fitness level, and training goals.
questions.solution_html:
• how the FITT formula can be individualized based on age, fitness level, and training
  • goals?
  • FITT = Frequency, Intensity, Time, Type
  • Age: Older individuals require lower intensity and longer recovery.
  • Fitness level: Beginners start with lower frequency and time; advanced athletes
  • train longer and harder.
  • Training goals:
  • Weight loss → higher frequency, moderate intensity
  • Strength → high intensity, lower reps
  • Endurance → longer duration, moderate intensity
  • FITT ensures a personalized, safe, and progressive training plan.
  • / [CO2]

questions.question: How can running long slow distances (LSD) help the development of aerobic capacity?
questions.solution_html:
• How can running long slow distances (LSD) help the development of aerobic
  • capacity?
  • LSD training:
  • Increases stroke volume of the heart
  • Enhances oxygen delivery to muscles
  • Improves mitochondrial density
  • Strengthens slow-twitch muscle fibers
  • Builds endurance with low injury risk
  • This results in greater aerobic capacity (VO₂ max) and stamina.
  • / [CO1]
